description: Original thermal trip values and HiCo candidate values derived from the device's own tuning rules.

value_semantics.delta_c: HiCo candidate minus original, in degrees Celsius.
value_semantics.hico_candidate_max_trip_c: Highest trip threshold produced by HiCo's validated tuning policy for the same artifact/section; candidate only, not a measured safety limit.
value_semantics.original_max_trip_c: Highest trip threshold present in the original mapped artifact/section.
